convert_groupvit_checkpoint: convert a GroupViT checkpoint from NVlabs to HuggingFace Transformers format and save locally
convert_state_dict: convert a GroupViT state dict from NVlabs naming to HuggingFace naming conventions
rename_key: rename a GroupViT checkpoint key from NVlabs to HuggingFace Transformers naming scheme
prepare_img: prepare a sample cat image from COCO dataset for verifying the converted GroupViT model
run_convert_cli: run the GroupViT checkpoint conversion script via argparse CLI with checkpoint path and output folder
